product_metadata.title: Hosley Bulk Pack of 108 Rattan Diffuser Reeds - Your Choice of Lengths (7")
features: PRODUCT: Hosley's Bulk Pack of 108 Rattan Diffuser Reeds

USE: These are perfect for adding a decorative touch to any room's decor. Designed to perk up your favorite diffuser paired with Hosley's diffuser oils to beautify fragrance into the air. Perfect for everyday use, wedding, events, aromatherapy,Spa, Reiki, Meditation, Bathroom setting.

BENEFITS: Bring a luscious, beautiful aroma to your home with our Hosley signature scented diffuser oils and a pretty glass bottle for worry-free home fragrance. This Diffuser Reeds will last the duration of most events. Once the event is done, these low cost solutions are easily disposable or can be reused for you next event. When using in your home as a decorative and fragrance accent.

HOSLEY BRAND PRODUCTS: Hosley brand products are made from quality raw materials with minimal wastage at every step of production. With the goal of achieving a neutral carbon footprint, please recycle and help leave Mother Earth better off for future generations.
description: Hosley's Set of 108, 7" High Rattan Diffuser Reeds. For use with diffuser oil. Create a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere in your home with these reed diffuser sticks. As the sticks soak up the fragrance it disperses throughout your home and will freshen the air and help assist in removing lingering odors, without the use of an open flame. Diffuser oil will fill your space with a pleasant aroma and a sense of tranquility as well as being excellent partners in sleeping, and yoga. Hosley diffuser oils are a perfect source to use with these reed sticks (Hosley Diffuser Oil Sold Seperate). Wrap them up as a gift or use them as a stocking stuffer. Spread these reed sticks around and share with your family and friends. Just simply pour the fragrance into a bottle and place your reeds into the diffuser oil. Flip reeds sticks over regularly (recommend 1x per week) to keep the fragrance strong. (Reed Sticks & Bottles Not Included). Instructions: Pour diffuser oil into diffuser bottle. Insert 6 to 10 diffuser reeds. Caution: Skin and eye irritant. Do not ingest. Keep out of reach of children and pets. May damage finished surfaces if spill occurs. Keep away from open flames (do not heat). Contains fragrance oils. Color of oil may vary.
